summary: A tight, engine-building worker-placement game where every turn is a puzzle of matching colored cards to board slots to unlock both an action and a card bonus, while managing a constant tension between borrowing resources now and paying interest later. It rewards efficient long-term planning over reactive play, with tableau/network building (domes, tunnels, production buildings) driving a slow but satisfying snowball toward the endgame scoring.
praised: Deep, satisfying puzzle of optimizing card-slot combos and action timing
Elegant loan/interest system that adds real risk-reward tension without feeling punishing
High replayability from the large pool of unique special cards
Smooth turn order/initiative track mechanic that keeps the game moving
criticised: Significant analysis paralysis, especially in the back half of the game
Player interaction is thin, closer to a multiplayer solitaire experience
Card draw luck can meaningfully affect available strategies each round
Steep initial learning curve and icon/rules overhead before it clicks

interaction.kind: mostly parallel play with light competition over shared card/action slots

scoring.why: Points accumulate from city/tunnel/dome networks, special cards, end-game bonus tiles, and efficient resource/loan management, so the winner is whoever builds the most efficient overall engine rather than maxing one track
